recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-28583 unless BR&R opens a new tracker to revisit the later substance/specifiedSubstance modeling decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-28583 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R R5 change request for FHIR-core-MedicinalProductIngredient asking to change Ingredient.Substance.code[x] and Ingredient.SpecifiedSubstance.code[x] to CodeableReference.
initial_application: Commit 0ee3e67a82c0c38d9b72a24283a41aefd527d296 applied the request in the Ingredient spreadsheet and examples by changing the relevant CodeableConcept|Reference choices to CodeableReference. Later source refactors moved the active definition to source/ingredient/structuredefinition-Ingredient.xml.
additional_context: Ingredient is the active current-build successor to the old MedicinalProductIngredient artifact. FHIR-31813 later removed Ingredient.specifiedSubstance, and FHIR-31812 later narrowed Ingredient substance CodeableReference targets to SubstanceDefinition only; both related decisions are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the surviving FHIR-28583 requirement and there is no remaining build-scoped specifiedSubstance or stale code[x] source surface to edit.

related_jiras.note: Removed Ingredient.specifiedSubstance from the current model, explaining why the second element named by FHIR-28583 no longer exists.
Removed Substance as a target from Ingredient substance CodeableReference elements, leaving SubstanceDefinition only.
The same historical implementation commit also applied CodeableReference changes to other medication definition resources, but those artifacts are outside this seed decision.
